section.content: The utility model discloses gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering, which comprises an equipment body, wherein the bottom of the equipment body is fixedly connected with a base, the bottom of the base is fixedly connected with a supporting block, the top of an inner cavity of the base is fixedly connected with an adjusting seat, the bottom of the adjusting seat is provided with a lifting seat, two sides of the top of the lifting seat are respectively provided with a limiting groove, the bottom of the lifting seat is fixedly connected with a lifting block, and the bottom of the lifting block penetrates through the inner cavity of the supporting block and is fixedly connected with a movable wheel. According to the gene detection device for the biological genetic engineering, the device body, the base, the supporting block, the adjusting seat, the lifting seat, the limiting groove, the lifting block, the moving wheel, the motor, the rotating rod, the cam, the moving block, the moving frame, the moving shell and the adjusting wheel are arranged, so that the problem that the existing gene detection device for the biological genetic engineering is low in practicability is solved, and the gene detection device for the biological genetic engineering has the advantage of high practicability.

本实用新型公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括设备本体，所述设备本体的底部固定连接有底座，所述底座的底部固定连接有支撑块，所述底座内腔的顶部固定连接有调节座，所述调节座的底部设置有升降座，所述升降座顶部的两侧均开设有限位槽，所述升降座的底部固定连接有升降块，所述升降块的底部贯穿至支撑块的内腔并固定连接有移动轮。本实用新型通过设置设备本体、底座、支撑块、调节座、升降座、限位槽、升降块、移动轮、电机、旋转杆、凸轮、移动块、移动架、移动壳和调节轮，解决了现有用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备实用性较低的问题，该用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，具备实用性高的优点。

Gene detection equipment for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of genetic engineering, in particular to genetic detection equipment for biological genetic engineering.

Background

The gene engineering is also called gene splicing technology and DNA recombination technology, it is based on the theory of molecular genetics, and by means of modern methods of molecular biology and microbiology, the genes from different sources are constructed in vitro according to the pre-designed blueprint, then the DNA molecules are introduced into living cells to change the original hereditary property of the organism, and the genetic technology of new species and new product production is obtained, the gene detection equipment is needed in the gene engineering, but most of the existing gene detection equipment has the problem of inconvenient movement, if it is needed to be moved, the pulley is usually installed at the bottom of the device, and the device is moved by the pulley, but the stability of the gene detection equipment is deteriorated and the displacement is easy to generate because the pulley is only contacted with the ground for supporting, and if the supporting leg is used for supporting, the device is inconvenient to move, the practicability of the gene detection equipment is reduced.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to provide gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering, which has the advantage of high practicability and solves the problem of low practicability of the conventional gene detection equipment for biological gene engineering.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model provides the following technical scheme: a gene detection device for biological gene engineering comprises a device body, wherein the bottom of the device body is fixedly connected with a base, the bottom of the base is fixedly connected with a supporting block, the top of an inner cavity of the base is fixedly connected with an adjusting seat, the bottom of the adjusting seat is provided with a lifting seat, two sides of the top of the lifting seat are respectively provided with a limiting groove, the bottom of the lifting seat is fixedly connected with a lifting block, the bottom of the lifting block penetrates through the inner cavity of the supporting block and is fixedly connected with a moving wheel, the bottom of the moving wheel extends to the bottom of the supporting block, the back of the adjusting seat is fixedly connected with a motor, the front side of the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating rod, the front end of the rotating rod penetrates through the inner cavity of the adjusting seat and is sleeved with a cam, two sides of the cam are respectively provided with a moving block, and one side opposite to the two moving blocks is fixedly connected with a moving frame, two opposite one ends of moving the frame all run through to the outside of adjusting the seat and fixedly connected with move the shell, the bottom fixedly connected with regulating wheel of moving the shell, the bottom of regulating wheel extends to the inner chamber of spacing groove.

Preferably, the inner chamber of the movable shell is provided with a fixed block, a first spring is fixedly connected to one side opposite to the two fixed blocks, a fixed rod is fixedly connected to one side opposite to the two fixed blocks, and one end, far away from the fixed blocks, of the fixed rod penetrates through the movable shell and is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the base.

Preferably, the number of the supporting blocks is four, and the limiting grooves are trapezoidal.

Preferably, the bottom of the adjusting seat is fixedly connected with a sliding rod, and the bottom of the sliding rod penetrates through the lifting seat and is fixedly connected with the bottom of the inner cavity of the base.

Preferably, the top of the movable shell is fixedly connected with a sliding block, and sliding grooves are formed in two sides of the top of the inner cavity of the base.

Preferably, the equal fixedly connected with of bottom of base both sides is spacing box, the inner chamber of spacing box is provided with the dog, and the inner chamber to the base all runs through to one side that two dogs are relative, the equal fixedly connected with pull rod in the opposite one side of two dogs, the surface cover of pull rod is equipped with the second spring, and the opposite one end of two pull rods all runs through to the outside and the fixedly connected with pull ring of spacing box.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the following beneficial effects:

1. according to the gene detection device for the biological genetic engineering, the device body, the base, the supporting block, the adjusting seat, the lifting seat, the limiting groove, the lifting block, the moving wheel, the motor, the rotating rod, the cam, the moving block, the moving frame, the moving shell and the adjusting wheel are arranged, so that the problem that the existing gene detection device for the biological genetic engineering is low in practicability is solved, and the gene detection device for the biological genetic engineering has the advantage of high practicability.

2. The lifting seat can be used for limiting the lifting seat by arranging the limiting box, the stop block, the pull rod and the second spring, and the moving shell can be moved conveniently by arranging the sliding block and the sliding groove.

In the figure: 1. an apparatus body; 2. a base; 3. a support block; 4. an adjusting seat; 5. a lifting seat; 6. a limiting groove; 7. a lifting block; 8. a moving wheel; 9. a motor; 10. rotating the rod; 11. a cam; 12. a moving block; 13. a movable frame; 14. moving the shell; 15. an adjustment wheel; 16. a fixed block; 17. a first spring; 18. fixing the rod; 19. a slide bar; 20. a limiting box; 21. a stopper; 22. a pull rod; 23. a second spring.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, and not all of the embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments given herein without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention.

limiting the lifting seat 5, through setting up slider and spout, can be convenient for remove the removal of shell 14, through setting up equipment body 1, base 2, supporting shoe 3, adjust seat 4, lift seat 5, spacing groove 6, elevator 7, remove wheel 8, motor 9, rotary rod 10, cam 11, movable block 12, remove frame 13, remove shell 14 and regulating wheel 15, solved the current lower problem of gene detection equipment practicality for biological genetic engineering, this a gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering possesses the advantage that the practicality is high.

When the device is used, the whole device can be moved by the matching of the moving wheels 8, after the device is moved to a required position, the pull rod 22 is pulled firstly, the pull rod 22 drives the two stop blocks 21 to be away from each other to remove the limitation on the lifting seat 5, then the motor 9 is controlled to operate to drive the cam 11 to rotate to remove the extrusion on the moving block 12, the first spring 17 is reset to drive the two moving shells 14 to move towards the middle, at the moment, the base 2 and the supporting block 3 can move downwards due to the action of gravity until the bottom of the supporting block 3 is contacted with the ground, the lifting seat 5 can move towards the upper part of the inner cavity of the base 2, at the moment, the whole device is supported by the supporting block 3, the stability of the whole device can be improved, when the device is required to be moved, the motor 9 is controlled to operate to drive the cam 11 to rotate to extrude the moving block 12, the moving block 12 drives the two adjusting wheels 15 to be away from each other to extrude the lifting seat 5 through the matching of the moving frame 13 and the moving shells 14, make lift seat 5 remove downwards, lift seat 5 drives through the cooperation of elevator 7 and removes wheel 8 and remove downwards until the bottom that removes wheel 8 is located supporting shoe 3 below, can remove whole device through the cooperation that removes wheel 8 afterwards.
